config.scope: A bounded continuation screen, not a full from-scratch architecture retrain.320fits=2arms*2families*4years*20seeds,3additionalepochs each. Existing checkpoints and all20seeds are spent development. No fresh market/seed holdout.
config.initialization: Start every matched pair from the same existing first-half-loss-selected checkpoint. Reset optimizer to AdamWlr0.00025wd0.001THINK or Adam lr0.000025dynamic;3epochs, batch8THINK/1dynamic, chronological order, clip1, deterministicFP32CUDA. No pretrained source is mutated.
config.matched_control: Both arms use two independent10%input-dropout passes and average the original supervised rank losses. THINK had no existingdropout;dynamic retains existinginternaldropout. Control reports KL but gives it weight0;consistency adds1*symKL between eligible cross-sectionalsoftmax(score/0.5) distributions. Same seed and RNG draws across paired arms.
config.averaging: Track parameter EMA decay0.99 after every optimizer step, initialized to source weights; copy fixed buffers. Evaluate raw/EMA trajectories separately. This is EMA,not an originalSWA reproduction andnot earlier averaging of selected predictions.
config.selection: For raw andEMA independently choose minimum original supervisedrank loss on prior-year firsthalf validation over epochs0,1,2,3; earliest ties. Epoch0 exactly preserves source. Secondhalf auditdiagnostics never choosecheckpoints. Allfitartifacts lock before any new financialaccount scores.
config.portfolio: Unchanged26week training prior50%+neuralranks50%. both uses25%THINK+25%dynamic;single-family controls use50%thatfamily. Select5issuers per fixed5seedcohort,20%basketvol20,continuousQQQshort<=75%/remaininggross/QQQvol;average cohorttargets. Same next-close,ADV,fees,calendarborrow,zero cashyield.
config.primary: Both-family prior ensemble: every7group baseSR improves original by>=0.02, fourdisjointspread<=0.25, no7group SR loss under2xfees/6%borrow. Consistency must also have positive worst7group mean delta versus its matched raw/EMA dropoutcontrol. Separateall7SR>1.5 flag. Family-only andsingle-seedresults arediagnostics;no seed filtering.
config.continuation: Only a passing consistency/EMA candidate justifies scaling this training recipe to a longer from-scratch budget. Architecture/prior-decomposition/multihorizon/portfolio-objective changes require separate frozen experiments; they are not silently mixed into this isolation study.
